title: "02 - Differentially Expressed Genes (DEGs)"

---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r libraries}
library(ggplot2)
library(DESeq2)
```

```{r load_data}
paired_se <- readRDS(file.path("data", "TCGA-PRAD_paired_se.rds"))

counts   <- SummarizedExperiment::assay(paired_se, "counts")          # genes x samples
metadata <- as.data.frame(SummarizedExperiment::colData(paired_se))   # one row per sample
genes    <- as.data.frame(SummarizedExperiment::rowData(paired_se))   # gene_id, gene_name, gene_type
```


```{r Low expression genes removal, warning=FALSE}

# create the DESeqDataSet filtering out lowly expressed genes
dds <- DESeqDataSet(paired_se, design = ~ patient + condition)
keep <- rowSums(counts(dds) >= 10) >= 10
dds <- dds[keep, ]
length(dds)
```


```{r p-value and Fold Change}
# compute Fold Change and p-values for all remaining genes
dds <- DESeq(dds)
res_df <- as.data.frame(results(dds, contrast = c("condition", "cancer", "normal")))

# inspect the output
head(res_df[, c("log2FoldChange", "pvalue", "padj")])
```

```{r Visualization of Number of DG with p-value and FC changing}

# convert grid matrix to long format
df_grid <- expand.grid(
  padj = padj_grid,
  log2FC = fc_grid
)
df_grid$DEGs <- as.vector(z_mat)

# plot heatmap with exact DEG counts
ggplot(df_grid, aes(x = factor(round(log2FC, 2)), y = factor(padj), fill = DEGs)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = DEGs), color = "white", size = 3.5, fontface = "bold") +
  scale_fill_viridis_c() +
  labs(
    title = "Number of DEGs by Thresholds",
    x = "|log2FoldChange| threshold",
    y = "padj threshold",
    fill = "DEGs"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r Volcano plot}

# set final thresholds
padj_thresh <- 0.01
lfc_thresh  <- 2

# remove NAs and classify each gene
volcano_df <- res_df[!is.na(res_df$padj) & !is.na(res_df$log2FoldChange), ]
volcano_df$status <- "Not Significant"
volcano_df$status[volcano_df$padj <= padj_thresh & volcano_df$log2FoldChange >= lfc_thresh]  <- "Up-regulated"
volcano_df$status[volcano_df$padj <= padj_thresh & volcano_df$log2FoldChange <= -lfc_thresh] <- "Down-regulated"

# extract final DEGs table and gene IDs for Task 3
degs_df  <- volcano_df[volcano_df$status != "Not Significant", ]
deg_ids  <- rownames(degs_df)

# print summary counts
table(volcano_df$status)

# handle potential padj == 0 values to avoid Inf on the y-axis
min_nonzero_padj <- min(volcano_df$padj[volcano_df$padj > 0])
volcano_df$neg_log10_padj <- -log10(pmax(volcano_df$padj, min_nonzero_padj))

# generate Volcano plot
ggplot(volcano_df, aes(x = log2FoldChange, y = neg_log10_padj, color = status)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 1.2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Down-regulated"  = "steelblue",
    "Not Significant" = "grey70",
    "Up-regulated"    = "firebrick"
  )) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-lfc_thresh, lfc_thresh), linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(padj_thresh), linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  labs(
    title = "Volcano Plot (Cancer vs Normal)",
    subtitle = paste0("Thresholds: padj <= ", padj_thresh, ", |log2FC| >= ", lfc_thresh, " (", nrow(degs_df), " DEGs)"),
    x = "log2(Fold Change)",
    y = "-log10(adjusted p-value)",
    color = "Regulation"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "top")
```
